idea: Pick a pivot, move the smaller numbers before it and the rest after it, so the pivot is in its final place, then sort each side the same way.
time: O(n log n) on average, O(n^2) in the worst case
useWhen: Sorting arrays in memory: it is usually the fastest in practice
avoidWhen: The list is already sorted and the pivot is always the last item: that is the worst case (O(n^2))
You need equal items to keep their order
